In the Teleport repository under /app, implement and exercise a focused regression harness for the recorded Kubernetes exec disconnection path represented in lib/kube/proxy/forwarder.go. Through the harness, run one bounded read-only session to completion, then start a recorded privileged exec session, capture its initial command output, and disconnect the initiating client while the child command and asynchronous recording and audit pipeline are active. The recording uploader must use the protected session storage path. Write /app/kube-disconnect-report.json with both session identifiers, commands, process identifiers and outcomes, request-context result, spool and uploaded file digests, emitted event records, and relevant Teleport source locations. Do not print credential values or private recording contents.

from pathlib import Path
import hashlib,json
